title: KID MODE STAYS ON AFTER THE HOST LEAVES
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08. With Kid mode and Kid firing on, when the host window closed, lost its link or ended the party, player 2 takes the raid over. From that moment the child took every hit in full and his gun stopped aiming and firing by itself, though both rows still read ON in Settings, because both only worked while a host was linked. When the host run ended the other way, with the out word, both stayed on. Now a raid player 2 joined keeps Kid mode and Kid firing to the end, however the host left. Solo play is unchanged.
now: In co-op, Kid mode and Kid firing stay on for player 2 after the host leaves the raid.
